pre_remediation_findings.title: Hardcoded GEMINI_API_KEY in Cloud Run Environment Variable (Positiva SGDA Pattern)
pre_remediation_findings.description: Plaintext API key detected in Cloud Run container env block. Exposes Vertex AI / Gemini quota and credentials if container environment or Terraform state is inspected.
pre_remediation_findings.remediation: Removed GEMINI_API_KEY env var in terraform/main.tf; migrated to keyless Vertex AI Application Default Credentials (ADC) + Google Secret Manager secret_key_ref.

pre_remediation_findings.title: Cloud Run Service Using Default Compute Service Account with roles/editor
pre_remediation_findings.description: Default compute service account granted project-wide roles/editor. If combined with SSRF (CM-SSRF-003), allows full lateral movement across GCP project jmaciasc.
pre_remediation_findings.remediation: Provisioned dedicated least-privilege service account linktic-sgda-runner@jmaciasc.iam.gserviceaccount.com in terraform/main.tf with scoped roles/aiplatform.user and roles/logging.logWriter.

pre_remediation_findings.title: Internet-Exposed Cloud Run Service Without Cloud Armor WAF Security Policy
pre_remediation_findings.description: Publicly accessible service lacks OWASP Top 10 pre-configured WAF rules for SQLi/RCE/Scanner defense at the edge.
pre_remediation_findings.remediation: Added google_compute_security_policy.linktic_sgda_waf in terraform/main.tf enforcing preconfigured SQLi (sqli-v33-stable) and RCE (rce-v33-stable) rules.
